scenes.title: Open the game
scenes.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / 3D game storyboard. Haru-machi is a SMALL personal two-player low-poly cel-shaded Three.js game. Actual reference screenshots define the art fidelity: simple faceted KayKit heroes, sculpted leaves, procedural flowers, modest Tudor cottages and wide valley. Retain those asset shapes and low-poly rendering; do not turn them into realistic humans, anime painted portraits, AAA photoreal assets or a new fantasy city. Knight: squat silver closed helmet, grey armor, red cape, one sword and shield. Mage: squat purple pointed hat with orange band, purple tunic, magenta cape, staff with pale green gem and small book. Exactly two heroes maximum; no third player, pets, companions or decorative angels. Calm warm sunlight, grass green, ivory stone, restrained aged brass and tiny blossom motif for actual sculpted UI. No excessive gold scrollwork, huge HUD, minimap, clock, inventory, mana bars, developer controls, unnecessary tutorial text, new currencies or unrelated RPG features. Never include any deity name, secret name, riddle solution, invented poem, dialogue by the god, or readable secret inscription. This is a concept, not a screenshot of implemented work. Landscape 16:9 full game screen, crisp legible few words, no physical device mockup or collage.
SCENE 01: TITLE SCREEN. A quiet field of the actual reference daisies, pink cosmos, purple lupines/bellflowers and simple grass catches warm morning sun. Low stone boundary, a few wisteria trees, distant valley hills; an ordinary winding path hints toward the small reference Tudor hamlet far away. Keep beautiful but achievable procedural low-poly meadow, no invented castle, waterfall or elaborate ruins. Foreground flowers compose the lower third, negative sky space for title. No heroes needed on this title screen. Precisely centered elegant title 'Haru-machi'. Beneath in small quiet typography 'Developed by Argon & Sol' then 'Directed by Vikas' then 'For Ishika'. One small sculpted ivory stone button 'Enter'. No Create/Join controls yet, no progress bar, no fighting HUD, no quests. Add tiny top-left corner label '01 · TITLE CONCEPT'.
